records: The prior Cointelegraph source record note incorrectly attributed Visa/Allium's H1 2026 adjusted stablecoin volume of $8.82T and USDC H1 share of about 70% to the Cointelegraph article. Direct inspection of the Cointelegraph article supports June adjusted volume of $1.79T and USDC June share of 67%; Finst's separate July 6 article supports the H1 $8.82T and 70% figures. The old record is preserved; this appended correction separates the source scopes.
